title: Alternative Investing: Alts For All - [Business Breakdowns, EP.234]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, we are back to talk about increased access to alternative investing.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we are back to talk about increased access to alternative investing. My guest is Josh Clarkson, managing director at Prosek Partners. You may remember that Josh joined us last year in our primer series on private credit.

key_points.text: He is back today to discuss what this development could mean for all the counterparties involved.
We put some numbers around the opportunity, cover what asset managers might be best positioned to capture it, the strategies that most naturally fit.
It is a fascinating theme that I expect to continue gaining momentum.
